title: peace that stays

verses.text: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.
You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.
The LORD gives His people strength; the LORD blesses His people with peace.

caption:
Some days peace is not a feeling you can summon. It is something handed to you.

Jesus does not offer the kind of calm the world sells, the kind that lasts until the next bit of news. His peace is given, and it stays. It holds a steady mind and it settles a troubled heart.

John 14:27, Isaiah 26:3 and Psalm 29:11 (BSB)

Save this for the day your mind will not settle. Then send it to someone who is carrying a lot right now.
